text:
jordan (pm): Quick sync — drafting the admission roadmap clauses for model catalog. Need cross-team signoff on launch gates, SLA bindings, and pin exceptions. 48h for feedback?

maya (eng): +1. Propose bench baseline: perf targets (p50/p95), regression <5% on eval slice, and a 1k-QPS cost estimate.

kevin (eng-plat): Infra asks: include quant configs and a memory footprint limit. Also require a dedicated canary run on the reserved pool for 48h.

sarah (cs): From Customer Success: enterprise customers expect pin TTL >= 90 days, migration playbook with opt-in credits, and an explicit rollback communications plan.

lina (legal): Heads up — a hard "pin terminates on 30-day notice" clause is risky for us. Suggest: "pin grace 90 days unless security/compatibility breach". Also need DPA language for Private deployments.

jordan (pm): Noted. Can we align on a single set of acceptance criteria? My draft minimal list: bench ok, 48h canary pass, SLA cadence doc, migration runbook, legal clause approved. Who owns the runbook?

maya (eng): Eng will own the runbook draft. I'll include the perf harness, sample prompt slices, and a short checklist for reproducible benchmarks.

kevin (eng-plat): Infra will own canary orchestration + dashboard. Proposed monitoring thresholds: error-rate <0.5%, cold-start p95 <200ms. We'll also provide a canary job template.

sarah (cs): CS will prepare customer-facing migration email + credits template. Quick Q: are migrations opt-in or auto for pinned customers? We recommend opt-in.

lina (legal): Opt-in is preferred from legal/contracting. Also require a dispute-resolution SLA for pinned customers in the contract annex.

jordan (pm): Draft decision: two lanes — Fast lane (30d pin TTL, self-serve, limited SLA) and Enterprise lane (90d pin TTL, migration credits, dedicated canary + SLA). Deliverables before GA: bench report, runbook, legal clause, CS comms, infra canary + dashboard.

ops-bot: Reminder: "roadmap-docs" PR opened by @jordan — CI passed :white_check_mark:.

kevin (eng-plat): One more logging ask: include trace-id propagation and kv-cache eviction metrics in the canary dashboard.

maya (eng): Will attach perf benchmarks and a short "how to create migration tests" section to the runbook.

sarah (cs): Scheduled customer preview for next Wed. Inviting a handful of beta customers to validate rollback flow and comms.

jordan (pm): Thanks everyone. I'll capture this into the epic and assign owners. If no objections in 48h I'll lock the scope and the acceptance checklist below.

```
Acceptance checklist:
- Bench: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 250ms, quality regression <= 5% on sampled prompts
- Canary: 48h pass, error-rate < 0.5%, KV eviction < threshold
- Docs: runbook + migration playbook + CS comms template
- Legal: pin clause + DPA language approved
- Infra: canary job + dashboard with trace-id + eviction metrics
```

jordan (pm): tagging owners: @maya (runbook), @kevin (canary + dashboard), @lina (legal clause), @sarah (customer comms).
